optimum_source: planted, then verified: the objective is sum_i |t_i| (see the degeneracy note on why `target` does not enter it) and t is non-negative with no constraints, so t*=0 attains 0, which is also the lower bound of a sum of magnitudes.
degeneracy: STRUCTURAL, on two counts. (1) The declared parameter `target` is never referenced by any term, so the model is min sum_i |t_i| rather than the min sum_i |t_i - target_i| its description promises; expressing the latter needs an abs over a two-term difference, which the flat Term schema cannot represent. (2) The formulation has no constraints, so the magnitudes are free to collapse to 0 for any data. The instance exercises the grounder's epigraph lifting of `abs` end to end, but its optimum is data-independent. See corpus/STATUS.md.
